instruction: Candid corporate medium shot of a bright office interior. The woman with dark brown hair in a dark blue blazer (R1) on the far left and the woman with curly dark hair in a black blazer (R4) lean forward, placing their hands into a central stack. In the center-right, the woman with long dark brown hair in a black blazer (R3) smiles facing forward, while the blonde woman in a teal top (R2) on the far right smiles in profile, both adding their hands to the huddle. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene.
